steps.content: Despite the council chamber's heavy soundproofing, the artillery outside announces itself as a deep, persistent tremor through the floor.
Augustus's gaze sweeps the room, silently tallying her trapped prey with amusement. One, two, three... eleven councilors. And one clerk. Just twelve people in total.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Even fewer than I expected. Couldn't even convince your own colleagues to join your little protest.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Last chance. Anyone want to change their mind?
Only a deathly silence answers her.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: ...I will not change my position. Surrendering now is pointless. As long as you plot to restore military rule, I will oppose you!
The others remain silent and unflinching. They stand firm, surrounded by guns, but in the end, not a single one steps forward to surrender.
A genuine smile finally graces Augustus's lips.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Good. I was hoping you'd say that.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Then let's stop the posturing. Time for the city-state's most stubborn councilors to see what DisCorps is really made of.
The lights abruptly die. In the darkness, a projection flares to life before the councilors, displaying a battered, broken army.
Their equipment is obsolete, their formations scattered. They look utterly vulnerable in the flickering light.

Augustus's gesture guides the projection upward, until it settles on a structure jutting from the wastes like a rusted tombstone: the ruins of Nirvana Port, its surface pockmarked by the unmistakable scars of a nuclear strike.
Long after the image fades, a stunned silence holds the chamber. Augustus intends to give them time to absorb the shock, but as the quiet stretches too long, she can't suppress a soft chuckle.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Heh. Sorry to disappoint. But this is the reality. How powerful did you think an army of exiles could be after years in the wilderness?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Our gear is obsolete. Our ranks can't be replenished. We've been wandering through sandstorms for years, struggling for basic supplies.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: These soldiers are covered in wounds, men who did the city-state's dirty work only to be cast aside. Mania corruption is eating them alive. Their morale is shattered; their minds are hanging by a thread.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: This... is the army I command. It can't defeat anything. It can only frighten you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: BR-003 is no different. Just a bluff. EDGE can't actually deliver precision catastrophic strikes. The enemy saw right through it. That's why they've ignored our warning and expanded the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But you? You're still lost in a fantasy. You fear us. You publicly reject us. But secretly, you still believe we'll somehow defeat the enemy at your doorstep.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Wake up! We can't save you. Only you can protect this city-state! So what are you waiting for?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Economics, logistics, intelligence—they're all battlefields. War tests the strength of an entire city-state. But your infighting and paranoia have turned the front-line FAC into a hollow shell.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: And what are the diplomats doing?! Get out there! Build alliances. Navigate the negotiations. You are soldiers in this war, too.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Stop the infighting. Stop the suspicion. Unite your allies. Pool your resources. Fight with everything you've got—your tactics, your wisdom, your very lives. Get up every time you fall. That is how you fight!

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So what if I try to seize power later? Then stand up to me like you are now. Show some backbone against intimidation. Unite and drive me back. It's that simple. That backbone is exactly why I chose you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Have you already forgotten the courage you just showed?
The recorder stares intently at the woman before him.
Is this some sort of manipulative rhetoric? He won't fall for it.
He will remember what these militants did when they seized power, even if everyone else forgets.
Exploiting the city-state's crisis for their own ends—that's what that person did. And she is no different. He can't afford to lower his guard. He must—
A raised hand in the silence cuts his thought short.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: I... on behalf of Nirvana, will provide supplies for the fight. It will take time, but I'll make it happen.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: You—

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: But I have conditions...
With a discreet swallow, the man races through his rehearsed points one last time. Then, steeling himself, he summons the courage to let the words tumble out in a single, rushed breath.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: These resources go under the FAC's unified management. They've been under long-term supervision. They've never betrayed our trust, and they have transparent protocols. They are the true backbone of this city's defense. That's who we support.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: If you truly have no intention of seizing power, if you really just want to protect this city-state... then prove it. Work with them.
The clerk stares at the Nirvana representative, dumbstruck.
Is he a spineless opportunist, or has he simply given up? Do they not realize how disastrous this will be?
Having finally managed to get through his carefully rehearsed speech, the Nirvana representative remains oblivious to the shocked stares around him.
[Enter Flashback]

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: You've got to be kidding me. Quinn is donating stockpiled resources to the FAC? Is that actually true? And why would they come to you of all people?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: My dear friend, is it not obvious? They've seen my livestreams! Everyone's reaching out! Plenty want to donate Hypercubes to support our brave soldiers in the FAC.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: It's done wonders for their reputation in the West District, I tell you. Some are even saying Quinn ought to have a hand in building the new mine.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: You can't be serious. Quinn's president is Eirene Campbell, from Fraser's Campbell family! DisCity would never let her get anywhere near the West District mine. The 9th Agency is already looking into her.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Now, now... when we talk about ties to Fraser, isn't Nirvana in a similar boat? The impression you left during the Great Expo... not so easily forgotten, hm?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Well... that... we could explain. We...

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Let's not dwell on the past! Focus on the future. Your rivals are already putting on quite the show of allegiance.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: It's not too late. Like you said, Nirvana's still a step above the Campbells. As long as you're willing to make a move, you won't lose to her.
With that, the Speaker handed over a check—a large sum, with an auspicious serial number that happens to be Parfait's favorite sequence of digits.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: ...I don't have the authority to deploy corporate assets. But there are... external contractors. I can send you their contacts.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Don't mention my name.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...Naturally. Your heroism will be remembered.
[Exit Flashback]

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: ...I'll keep in mind what you said. In the face of a crisis that threatens our very home, we have much to do. Cooperation with you is... necessary.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: ...But if during this time DisCorps causes trouble, if you try to overstep... I will stand against you immediately.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Excellent. You've finally learned to take the first step.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So, for our next move—
Bam—
The heavily guarded door splinters open. Several silhouettes stand framed in the doorway, backlit by the harsh light.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Enough pretty speeches.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Show me your battle plans. Prove you can win.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Of course.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Regaining trust always comes at a price. So tell me, are you ready to let the old foxes slip a collar on you?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: That depends what kind of collar you mean.
[Chief's portrait]
She watches you, a calculating smile on her lips.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: These shackles are tied to the Black Ring. Accepting them means accepting the contamination, doesn't it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm under the impression you need it to achieve your goals.
You walk toward her as you speak, just as you did yesterday when everything that mattered had been said.
[Enter Flashback]

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You've come.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Our partnership ended a long time ago. Took you long enough to come say goodbye.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not here to say goodbye. I'm here to return to the battlefield.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You and your troops still need someone who can fight alongside you, don't you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If taking the entire city-state was something you could do alone, you wouldn't have come to me in the first place. You wouldn't have waited.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said you need someone who can fight with you. Does that person have to be a soldier?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is my first war; I was thrown into it. I tried to fight like a soldier because I wanted to protect the people I love.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I failed. That approach didn't work; it only caused more pain for them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even so, I still want to stay. To remain on the battlefield, but in my own way.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After all, war isn't just about hatred and killing. And victory isn't just about crushing the enemy. Don't you agree, General?
[Scene Change]
MK's feed is constantly updating. Once a major internet celebrity, he now commands everyone's attention with every comment he makes about the ongoing chaos.

In addition to Quinn and Nirvana's full support, the DisCity council has received a massive amount of mysterious funding from the Outlands, and through the same channel, they have bought a huge supply of Hypercubes.
This should have been impossible. Fraser never trusts outsiders on strategic operations. How could this possibly be?

Nevertheless, when MK shares the news, people find a new sense of hope. As public tension quickly eases, so does hostility, leading to a significant drop in the disputes, conflicts, and violent incidents that have been troubling the city-state.
[Scene Change] Detention Cell

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Those Outland elite operatives are too organized. They had to have inside help. If we can trace their comms, we might find the source.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: You said you could fix this, so hurry up. This war with them makes me sick.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Excellent work, Miss Stewart. You've got more talent than I gave you credit for. I'll pay you a visit when this wraps up.
[Scene Change] Flashback, Nirvana Port Command Center

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now to answer your question...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You asked me... what I'd do if I gave it everything I had... and still couldn't bring Hella back...
Answering this question proves so difficult, yet you refuse to give up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I really... lost her...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'd get back up. And I'd destroy BR-005...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then... BR-003. BR-000. All of them. And every single bastard who creates them, every opportunist who tries to profit from them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hatred won't heal me. The pain and suffering... they're half from the Mania itself, and half from those vultures who feed on them. From now on, they're my enemies. I don't care about city-states or stances; none of it matters now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From now on, wherever Mania rages, that's my battlefield. My enemy is all the suffering it brings. What happened to Hella, what I've been through... I won't let that happen to anyone else.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So no matter what it costs me, no matter how many times I fail... even if it takes the rest of my life. I'll keep fighting until I achieve total victory. Or until I die.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That... is my answer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't be your soldier, but it seems like we're headed to the same battlefield. If it's acceptance and trust you're looking for, you can find it in me—as your comrade.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Right now, I'm fighting to end this Black Ring war. Would you be willing to stand shoulder to shoulder with someone like that?
[Council]
You step up to Augustus. Taking her sword from Iron Mask's grasp, you offer it back to its rightful owner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: DisCorps's name is already synonymous with pure, unchecked violence. It's a name people fear. If you're going to lead it, I trust you're ready for that weight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even the sharpest blade needs a scabbard. Otherwise, it can't be carried. It's the same with Sinners and the shackles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm ready, too. We'll shoulder every risk together, and claim victory as one.
A smile graces her lips.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Heh, you truly are worthy of my attention. So what are we waiting for?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Let's move. My blade's getting impatient.
[Scene Change]
